why: Skip house i (keep dp[i−1]) or rob it (nums[i] + dp[i−2]).

q: House Robber II (houses in a circle): how do you reuse House Robber I?
why: The first and last houses can't both be robbed, so exclude one or the other.

q: Coin Change with coins [2] and amount 3 returns…
why: 3 can't be made from 2s; dp[3] stays infinity → −1.

q: In O(n²) LIS, where is the answer?
why: dp[i] is the longest increasing subsequence ENDING at i; the best can end anywhere.

q: Maximum Product Subarray: why track the minimum product too?
options: A negative number turns the smallest product into the largest
why: The best product ending here can come from the previous minimum times a negative.
